Name: RelicAuras
Author: s1lence17
Description:
[b]Core Mechanics & Features[/b]
[b]What's new in version 1.1.0:[/b]
[list]
[*]Smart Visual Grid: When approaching an active pedestal or holding an artifact near an empty pedestal, a semi-transparent green grid will appear, displaying the exact area of effect. The grid dynamically adjusts its size based on the specific artifact you are using.[/*]
[*]Two new auras for animal husbandry (Chicken Statue and Elvish Jewelry).[/*]
[*]Balance update: Dwarf Scroll I radius reduced from 15 to 7 tiles for better game balance.[/*]
[/list][b]How it works:[/b] Craft the Artifact Pedestal. The recipe is automatically added when you load your save. Place the desired artifact on it. It will beautifully levitate above the pillar without the standard in-game item "bubbles". The effect activates automatically within a specific radius. To retrieve the artifact, simply click on the pedestal again.
[b]Available Auras and Artifacts:[/b]
[b]Animal Husbandry (New)[/b] Works within a 9x9 tile radius (4 tiles in every direction).
[list]
[*]Chicken Statue (Quality Aura): Scans Barns and Coops within its range. Every morning, the quality of animal products (milk, wool, truffles) and any eggs or feathers on the floor is magically upgraded.[/*]
[*]Elvish Jewelry (Pasture Aura): Plant at least one Grass Starter in the area of effect, and every night the aura will cause the grass to rapidly spread to empty dirt tiles, providing your animals with endless food.[/*]
[/list][b]Production Aura (Machine Speed Boost)[/b] Magically reduces the processing time of any machines (Furnaces, Kegs, Preserves Jars, etc.) within a 7x7 tile radius (3 tiles in every direction from the pedestal). The effect triggers instantly when the machine starts working.
[list]
[*]Rusty Spoon: Speeds up production by 10%.[/*]
[*]Ancient Cog: Speeds up production by 25%.[/*]
[*]Rare Disc: Speeds up production by 40%.[/*]
[/list][b]Fertility Aura (Crop Quality Boost)[/b] Works within an 11x11 tile radius (5 tiles in every direction).
[list]
[*]Amphora: Scans your fields every morning. If a crop is fully grown and ready for harvest, the aura has a 50% chance to magically apply Deluxe Fertilizer to its soil (guaranteeing silver, gold, or iridium quality upon harvest).[/*]
[/list][b]Guardian Aura (Farm Protection)[/b] Works within a 15x15 tile radius (7 tiles in every direction).
[list]
[*]Dwarf Scroll I: The pedestal acts as a Deluxe Scarecrow, protecting a huge area from crows. Additionally, every morning, the aura evaporates any newly spawned stones, twigs, and weeds, carefully restoring the hoed dirt underneath them so your crops stay safe.[/*]
[/list]Supported Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian.

Manifest.Name: Relic Auras
Manifest.Description: Craft pedestals and place artifacts on them to create powerful auras around your farm.
Manifest.Author: s1lence17
